finish.signature: One continuous long raised brow on the gold blade and a distinct near-black eyeball near the blade heel. Do not carve the whole eagle head.

brow.position: Sweeps from central blade toward its distal tip, terminating thicker above the eye near blade heel
brow.type: Long embossed 2D metallic relief on blade face, only one brow line

eye.position: Blade face near the base at the user's red spot, not on grip
eye.material: Smoky dark inset with subtle gold rim and tiny reflection

feathers.type: Heavy feathers removed; only naturally inherited neutral metal grain remains

motif-zone.material: burnished sculpted gold and near-black eye

ring.material: warm gold structural trim with dark interior

hardware.material: blackened steel and minimal gold fasteners

finish.decalRules: No complete carved bird face; only the brow and eyeball should be recognizable.

gameIntegration: reel, inventory, catalog preview and inspect WebPs

masterRequirements.orientation: blade tip right, finger ring left
masterRequirements.nativeSource: full-frame single object, not collage crop
masterRequirements.alpha: true transparent background, clear open ring hole

plannedOutputs.source: assets/source/karambit/neutral-master-2400.png (full editable source archived in Library ZIP; not currently committed as PNG)

notes: Original Raptor's Gaze design rejected; archived only for file provenance. Current Legendary Karambit is Starfall; existing instances migrate to it.
qualityNote: Original native knife artwork ~960px wide from generated comparison source, upsampled at inspect 1600px. 2D simulated metal brow, not physical 3D geometry.
finishingMethod: Neutral blade gold recolor plus one shaded cubic-Bezier raised brow and independent near-heel inset eyeball, both alpha-clipped to unchanged neutral mask.
